title: Study of AQUACEL™ Ag Surgical Cover Dressing Following Total Knee Replacement
brief_summary: The aim of the study is to determine whether the AQUACEL™ Ag SURGICAL cover dressing is successful in reducing the incidence of wound infection in high risk patients following total knee replacement. We will also look at the status of the wound, occurrence of blistering, biochemistry results, dressing wear time and the number of dressing changes to quantify the dressing performance.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* BMI ≥ 40
* Revision of total knee replacement
* Rheumatoid arthritis or secondary arthritis
* Patients on Warfarin
* Patients on steroids
* Patients on long term antibiotics
* Previous deep joint infection

Exclusion Criteria:

* Allergy to silver
* Simultaneous bilateral total knee replacement patients
* Patients who do not wish to participate
* Patients who are unable to give informed consent
* Patients who are unable to attend Golden Jubilee National Hospital for follow up
